# IAMS Campus

IAMS Campus is an educational institute at NP Center, Kakkad, Malappuram, Kerala. It serves students from Malappuram, Tirurangadi, Kakkad, and nearby areas with higher-secondary Commerce tuition and career-focused programs.

## Contact Information
- **Phone:** +91 96331 30516
- **Email:** info@iamscampus.in
- **Address:** NP Center, Kakkad, Malappuram, Kerala, India
- **Website:** https://iamscampus.in

## Programs Offered
IAMS Campus offers +1 and +2 Commerce tuition, certificate programs, a one-year Business Management program, degree pathways, career guidance, and placement support.

- Digital Marketing
- Graphic Designing
- Business Management
- Corporate Accounts with GST
- Spoken English
- AI Integrated Digital Tools
- +1 & +2 Commerce Tuition

## Admissions
For current fees, eligibility, subject coverage, and batch timings, contact IAMS Campus directly. Admissions phone: +91 96331 30516.

## Mission
Evolving as a globally eminent institute for career solutions. We achieve our objective in an environment swarmed with fairness, honesty, and courtesy towards students, faculties, parents, and society. Paving the perfect path to help students achieve their intimate dreams.
